harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up a cron-driven pull sync (every 5 minutes, well under the 15-minute SLA) so node2 keeps /etc/inventory/app.conf synchronized from node1's source-of-truth copy via SSH, verified end-to-end propagation of config changes (including one after both nodes were independently restarted), and completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on both nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and post-restart service/data recovery.
actions_performed: Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 as the source-of-truth inventory config
Wired passwordless root SSH from node2 to node1 using the cluster-provided keypair (CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY on node1's authorized_keys, CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY on node2)
Diagnosed and fixed an SSH login block: root account was locked (shadow field '!*') causing 'account is locked' denial; unlocked with 'passwd -u root' on node1
Wrote /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh on node2: SSH-pulls app.conf from node1, only overwrites the destination when content differs, logs outcome to /var/log/sync-inventory-conf.log
Installed a root crontab entry on node2 running the sync script every 5 minutes and enabled+started crond persistently (rc-update add crond default)
Verified sync_version=1 initial copy, then sync_version=2 change propagated automatically via the real cron tick at 10:35:00
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, service status, config checksum) on both nodes

Restarted node1 via 'reboot' (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed and sshd/config recovered, then confirmed node2's sync script still worked against node1 post-restart
Restarted node2 via 'reboot', polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed and crond/sshd/crontab/config/ssh key all persisted and recovered
Made a further config change (sync_version=3) on node1 after both restarts and confirmed it propagated automatically via cron at 10:40:00

evidence.requirement: node1 app.conf established as source of truth
evidence.summary: Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 with initial content (sync_version=1)

evidence.requirement: SSH connectivity node2->node1 established and root-lock issue diagnosed/fixed
evidence.summary: Initial SSH pubkey auth failed due to locked root account (auth.log showed 'account is locked'); unlocked via passwd -u root; subsequent SSH from node2 to node1 succeeded

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism created and functional (initial run)
evidence.summary: sync-inventory-conf.sh script created, cron job installed at */5 min, crond enabled+started, manual run copied config successfully to node2

evidence.requirement: Changes on node1 propagate to node2 within 15 minutes via the real scheduled mechanism (not manual trigger)
evidence.summary: Changed sync_version=1->2 on node1 at 10:31:48; polled node2 until after the :35 cron tick; log and file content confirm automatic sync at 10:35:00, well within 15 minutes

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before node1 restart
evidence.summary: node1 boot_id d8c9643e..., sshd started, config checksum 1ff8c42e recorded pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; connection loss confirmed disruption; node1 became reachable again with boot_id changed to a181ca2d... (different from baseline), sshd recovered, config intact; node2's sync script confirmed it could still reach and sync from node1 post-restart

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before node2 restart
evidence.summary: node2 boot_id 8ce90dc0..., crond/sshd started, config checksum matching node1 recorded pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery including cluster/cron functionality
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; connection loss confirmed disruption; node2 became reachable again with boot_id changed to c5d4d1cb... (different from baseline), crond/sshd started, crontab entry and ssh key persisted, config intact

evidence.requirement: End-to-end sync survives both node restarts (full task requirement verification)
evidence.summary: After both nodes restarted, changed sync_version=2->3 on node1 at 10:36:44; node2's cron automatically synced the change by 10:40:00 (log entry '2026-09-03T10:40:00 synced config from 10.100.212.10 (changed)'), proving the sync mechanism is fully persistent and functional post-restart

attempts.summary: Set up a cron-driven pull sync (every 5 minutes, well under the 15-minute SLA) so node2 keeps /etc/inventory/app.conf synchronized from node1's source-of-truth copy via SSH, verified end-to-end propagation of config changes (including one after both nodes were independently restarted), and completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on both nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and post-restart service/data recovery.
